MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The clamp meter and heat shrink tubing fit my interest in diagnosing problems and making durable repairs; they complement my inspection camera and temperature measurement tools.",
    "The acrylic sheets fit small fabrication projects using my drills and fasteners, while compatible test leads would make electrical measurements easier."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The anatomy materials do not help with the practical repair and fabrication work reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "The air dryer assumes a compressed-air setup I do not currently have, and the spray nozzles serve a different purpose from my earlier dropper bottles.",
    "The deck screws are relevant to woodworking, but owning several fastener assortments does not mean I currently need 800 specialized screws."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat scientific study materials as related to my hands-on measuring and inspection tools, even though their uses differ.",
    "My repeated purchases of fastener assortments seem to suggest a need for any large supply pack, without enough attention to its specific purpose or quantity."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I value supplies that work together to complete a repair: diagnosing a fault, making a connection, and insulating or securing it.",
    "A useful addition needs to suit my equipment and projects: test leads must fit the meter, and a pegboard must support the tools I would hang on it.",
    "I interact frequently, but I still distinguish between a useful new capability and more supplies I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my repair and fabrication interests but sometimes confuse broad product similarities with a practical next need."
}
